question: In which year Dadabhai Naoroji became the first Indian member of the House of Commons in the United Kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1892**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** became the first Indian member of the House of Commons in the United Kingdom in the year **1892**.
 
• He contested the election as a candidate of the **Liberal Party** and won the seat for Central Finsbury.
 
• Naoroji's election to the British Parliament was a significant milestone in the Indian independence movement, as he advocated for Indian rights and self-governance.
 
• He is also known as the **"Grand Old Man of India"** and was a key figure in the early Indian National Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was one of the founding members of the Indian National Congress in **1885**.
 
• He is known for his work on the economic impact of British rule in India, particularly through his book **"Poverty and Un-British Rule in India."**
 
• Naoroji's efforts laid the groundwork for future leaders in the Indian independence movement, including **Mahatma Gandhi** and **Jawaharlal Nehru**.
 
• He was also a professor of mathematics and natural philosophy and was actively involved in social reforms.
